Nothing is ## saved. ## * POST action=saveInstance: saves the "requireAuthentication", "clientId" and "clientSecret" of the instance "id", ## renamed from "previousId" when it's not empty, using its "url" and "deploymentType". An empty "previousId" means a ## new instance, which doesn't reuse settings left for the same ID. When the settings fields aren't sent (no ## "clientId"), the current settings are kept; an empty secret keeps the current one. ## * POST action=deleteInstance: removes the settings of the instance
